scope: Fixed offline semantic-part corpus, one source cell plus one complete-junction halo. Not prepared runtime LODs, an occlusion product or global stable-ID schema.
native_payload_indexing: positions/normals/colours Float32 words and original global UInt32 indices, little endian. Counts and base_vertex remain original. Every part references only its own newly emitted vertex interval; subtract base_vertex when making an independently owned mesh.
identity_scope: edge/junction/lane/node/contact identifiers are original values scoped by this frozen source/plan; not global stable IDs across source revisions/reordering. Provider IDs are supplied separately with source tile/layer/ring.
boundary_scope: All incident edges of selected junctions have full payload. Endpoints beyond that one-ring halo retain exact source edge/port/junction metadata as boundary references, without payload. This is not a complete regional road graph.
native_input_comparison: generated and warm-original road position/normal/colour/index words, part material and placement exactly equal; baseline/capture final1280x720RGBA identical; Core/Sync validation noVUIDs; original assets/packages/index unchanged.
